haikus.haiku:
Cherry crusts warm, crisp
Sweet pink filling sighs in steam
Golden dust swirls, joy
Happy #NationalCherryTurnoversDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Bow ties twirl in sun
Bright loops thread laughter and joy
Colors dance ribbons
Happy #NationalBowTieDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Pages old but warm
Tea steam curls, lemon scent bright
Words like cakes rise high
#HappyBirthdayLeoTolstoy from @ClamBakeSanta

Morning sun smiles soft
Leaves rustle, amber light drifts
Ink swirls on fresh page
#HappyBirthdayGoethe from @Cl

Silver glow rises
Crickets hum a quiet hymn
Night breathes deep soft blue
Happy #FullMoon from @ClamBakeSanta
